title: console: a `type: 'form'` record action leaves the app — it opens /forms/<object>.form outside the app shell, titled with the raw view name and with no Cancel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi7SkqaNxU2Ef8P2DMmp2hPJ)_

Found during an exploratory walkthrough of the showcase.

## Environment

- objectui `main` @ `6fb31dc` (console dev server, :5180), objectstack `main` @ `b9c7a8f` showcase on :3000, dev admin, zh-CN

## Steps

1. Open any showcase task record, e.g. `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/<id>`.
2. Click **Log Time** in the record header. It is the showcase's `showcase_log_time` action: `type: 'form'`, `target: 'showcase_task.form'`, `locations: ['record_header', 'record_related', 'record_section']`.

## Actual

- The browser navigates to `/forms/showcase_task.form?recordId=<id>&recordObject=showcase_task`.
- That page is outside the app: the app sidebar, the app switcher and the app's purple branding are gone, and the top bar falls back to the generic ObjectOS chrome.
- The page heading is the raw qualified view name **`showcase_task.form`**, not a label.
- The form has only **提交 / Submit**; there is no Cancel or back control, so the only way out without saving is the browser's Back button.
- After Submit it does return to the record page (toast 已提交), so the round trip works; it is the detour that feels broken.

Every other create/edit form in the console (the 新建 / 编辑 buttons) opens as a dialog over the current page (`?form=new`, `?form=<id>`), so the same task's edit form behaves two different ways depending on which button opened it.

## Expected

A form action fired from inside an app opens the form in the app's own overlay (dialog or drawer) like the built-in edit, or at least on a route inside the app shell, with the form view's label as its title and a Cancel that returns to where the user was.

(Separately and showcase-side: "Log Time" targets the task's general edit form, so the label promises a time-logging form it does not have. That is a metadata choice in the showcase, mentioned only so the two are not confused.)
